title: 第二十二章 空棺里的孩子
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
后堂一共九口薄棺。

    棺木不厚，钉得也粗糙。义庄收无主尸，本就没有谁会用好木头。沈清萝绕着棺材走了一圈，越走眉头越紧。

    九口棺，对应停尸簿上的九具无主尸。

    可有三口，太轻了。

    燕不归让役吏撬开第一口。

    里面空的。

    第二口，也是空的。

    第三口打开时，魏老头已经跪下了。

    “不是我偷的啊！我亲手送出去的，我真亲手送出去的！尸体是送去乱葬沟了，怎么棺还空着，我不知道啊！”

    沈清萝没看他，只蹲到棺底。

    棺底有一层浅浅灰印。

    不是骨灰。

    是魂灰。

    阿青贴近看了看：“像有东西在这里躺过，又被人从名字上剥走了。”

    燕不归皱眉：“魂灰不能作证。”

    “那就问棺。”

    谢无咎冷声：“棺是死物。”

    沈清萝已经拿起引魂铃。

    “棺材见过最后一面。有时候，比活人记性好。”

    她用铃舌轻敲棺沿。

    一下。

    两下。

    第三下落下，空棺底部忽然传出细细的哭声。

    魏老头“哎哟”一声，差点往燕不归身后钻。

    燕不归没让他钻。

    棺底慢慢浮起一点灰白魂影。起初只有一团，后来才像个孩子，瘦瘦小小，头发乱得像草，身上穿着不合身的破衣。

    他一出来，看见谢无咎，吓得“嗖”一下缩了回去。

    沈清萝：“……”

    糖糕伸爪按住棺沿：“你站远点啊，你看你把孩子吓的。”

    谢无咎面无表情。

    “我没动。”

    阿青也小声道：“你不动也挺吓人的。”

    宋砚默默看向屋梁。

    沈清萝回头：“谢无咎，退半步。”

    谢无咎：“双生契。”

    “半步不会死。”

    “你确定？”

    沈清萝叹气，把斗篷拉了拉。

    “那你站门边，别往这儿看。你一看他，他魂都结巴了。”

    谢无咎冷着脸站到门边。

    他不看棺材。

    他看沈清萝。

    沈清萝当没看见。

    阿青飘到棺边，蹲下身，声音放软：“出来吧，他不吃小孩。”

    糖糕想了想：“一般也不吃猫。”

    谢无咎：“……”

    棺底的小魂影又慢慢探出来。

    他看着沈清萝身上的黑斗篷，忽然又往后缩。

    “黑袖子……”

    沈清萝低头看自己。

    好。
content_en:
There are nine thin coffins in the back hall.

The coffin was not thick and the nails were rough.Yizhuang collects corpses without owners, and no one knows how to make good use of wood.Shen Qingluo walked around the coffin, her brows getting tighter as she walked.

The nine coffins correspond to the nine ownerless corpses on the morgue.

But three mouthfuls are too light.

Yan Bugui asked the servant to pry open the first mouth.

It's empty inside.

The second bite was also empty.

When the third mouth was opened, Old Wei had already knelt down.

"I didn't steal it! I sent it away with my own hands, I really sent it away with my own hands! The body was sent to the mass grave. Why is the coffin still empty? I don't know!"

Shen Qingluo didn't look at him and just squatted at the bottom of the coffin.

There is a light gray mark on the bottom of the coffin.

Not ashes.

It's soul ashes.

Ah Qing took a closer look and said, "It seems like something has been lying here before and someone stripped it of its name."

Yan Bugui frowned: "Soul ashes cannot bear witness."

"Then ask the coffin."

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "The coffin is a dead thing."

Shen Qingluo had already picked up the soul-inducing bell.

"The coffin has seen the last time. Sometimes, the memory is better than that of the living."

She tapped the edge of the coffin with the tongue of the bell.

one time.

Two times.

After the third drop, a thin cry suddenly came from the bottom of the empty coffin.

Old Man Wei said "Ouch" and almost got behind Yan Bugui.

Yan Bugui didn't let him get into it.

A gray-white soul slowly floated from the bottom of the coffin.At first it was just a ball, but later it looked like a child, thin and small, with hair as messy as grass and wearing ill-fitting rags.

As soon as he came out and saw Xie Wujiu, he was so frightened that he shrank back.

Shen Qingluo: "..."

Tanggai stretched out her paws to hold the edge of the coffin: "Stand away, you look like you're scaring the child."

Xie Wujiu's face was expressionless.

"I didn't move."

Ah Qing also whispered: "It's quite scary if you don't move."

Song Yan looked at the roof beam silently.

Shen Qingluo turned around and said, "Thank you Wu Jiu, take a half step back."

Xie Wujiu: "Twin life contract."

"You won't die if you take half a step."

"Are you sure?"

Shen Qingluo sighed and pulled her cloak.

"Then stand by the door and don't look here. When you look at him, his soul will stutter."

Xie Wujiu stood by the door with a cold face.

He doesn't look at the coffin.

He looked at Shen Qingluo.

Shen Qingluo pretended not to see it.

Ah Qing floated to the coffin, squatted down, and softened his voice: "Come out, he doesn't eat children."

Tang Cake thought for a while: "I generally don't eat cats either."

Xie Wujiu: "..."

The little soul shadow at the bottom of the coffin slowly came out again.

He looked at the black cloak on Shen Qingluo's body and suddenly shrank back.

"Black sleeves..."

Shen Qingluo looked down at herself.

good.
